anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a consistent radius transitioning from the dorsal cranium to the rostral indentation.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt projection with high pixel thickness relative to length, extending approximately 45 pixels from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle approximately 140 degrees visible at the pixel junction of the melon and the dorsal rostrum margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Thin, linear superficial marks visible on the lateral melon and upper flank area.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced light caustic refraction patterns on the mid-dorsal surface; visible dark pigmentation surrounding the eye.
